title: Connect a chat

intro.telegram: Add Leo to a Telegram group. Leo answers there only when someone writes to it.
intro.slack: Install the Slack app and pick the channels Leo may read.

fields.bindingHint: Tasks Leo makes from this chat land here.
fields.notice: {mode, select, all {Shosai stores every message of this chat} other {Shosai stores the messages written to Leo}} {home, select, ru {in Russia} other {in the EU}} for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, including messages of people who don’t use Shosai. Everyone in the chat sees that Leo is there.
fields.noticeRequired: Accept this to connect the chat.

telegram.mentionsHint: Leo sees messages that mention @{bot} or reply to it. Digests aren’t available.
telegram.allHint: Leo keeps every message, so it can make digests. You’ll make Leo an admin of the group.
telegram.adminExplained: Telegram sends every message of a group only to its admins. You can switch off all of Leo’s admin rights: it still gets the messages.
telegram.history: Telegram gives Shosai only messages written after Leo joins the group.

add.open: Open Telegram and pick the group
add.openAdmin: Open Telegram and add Leo as an admin
add.manual: Or add @{bot} to the group yourself and send:
add.expiresIn: {minutes, plural, =0 {The code is about to expire} one {The code works for # more minute} other {The code works for # more minutes}}
add.expiredHint: Get a new code and send it to the group while it works.

refusal.title: The group wasn’t connected
refusal.chat_already_connected: This group is connected to another workspace. Disconnect it there first.
refusal.not_a_group: Leo can join only a group. Send the code from a group, not a channel or a private chat.
refusal.wrong_chat: The code came from another group. Send it from the group you’re reconnecting.
refusal.connections_full: This workspace already has the most chats it can have.

connected.title: Connected to “{chat}”
connected.makeAdmin: Make Leo an admin of the group so it gets every message. All its admin rights can be off.

copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it.
